name: config
description: The config app — a web face for core/config's Config class (dict with attribute access and a clean aligned tree repr). Browse every fleet module's config.json rendered as the Config tree (collapse nested blocks, click a row to copy its dot-path, flip to raw JSON), paste any JSON into the playground to see its tree, and read the library's doc + source. Zero-dependency single-port app; fleet data reuses orbit/configs.
